item.title: Lavoro intelligente. Chi misura chi? / Intelligent work. Who measures whom?
item.description: IT: Aristotele sognava la spola che tesse da sola. A Bologna, al Jobless Society Forum, quella spola aveva cominciato a misurare chi lavora. — EN: Aristotle dreamed of the shuttle that weaves by itself. In Bologna, at the Jobless Society Forum, that shuttle had begun to measure those who work.
